title: The Bear and the Bee
text:
Once there was a little bear. He lived near a lake. The bear was very hungry. He liked honey.

One day, the bear saw a bee near the lake. The bee had a lot of honey. The bee said, 'Help me find my flower, and I will give you honey.' The bear found the flower. The bee gave him honey.

options: In a cave on a hill

questions.text: What did the bee have a lot of?
Why did the bee ask the bear for help?
options: She could not find her flower
She was too hungry to fly
She wanted to make a new friend
She was sad about the lake

questions.text: What kind of bear is he at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a sweet, thick food made by bees
a large area of water surrounded by land
the colourful part of a plant

paragraph_translations: Dawno temu żył sobie mały miś. Mieszkał blisko jeziora. Miś był bardzo głodny. Lubił miód.
Pewnego dnia miś zobaczył pszczołę nad jeziorem. Pszczoła miała bardzo dużo miodu. Pszczoła powiedziała: 'Pomóż mi znaleźć mój kwiat, a dam ci miodu.' Miś znalazł kwiat. Pszczoła dała mu miód.
